newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU sugar agenda brought forward.
newsitem.headline: EU sugar agenda brought forward.

text.p: The European Union's sugar management committee is expected to bring forward end-of-the-month agenda items to Wednesday as there is no meeting next week because of the Easter holiday, an EU member state official said.

In addition to the usual export tenders the committee is expected to deal with fortnightly periodic export refunds, syrup export refunds, quarterly chemical industry production refunds and non-Annex II processed product export refunds.
"There is no meeting next week and the agenda lists items normally dealt with at the end of the month," the official said.
The committee will also set molasses import duties.
The next meeting of the sugar management committee is scheduled for April 2. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
